additional_info.subject: Case creation notes
additional_info.body:
Hello. The Charger in scope have several Warnings in the event list ("Warning - Error causing out of service"). The time period that warnings happened was today from 10:43:39 to 10:51:24 (GMT+1 time). In this period a customer tried to charge several times, but the charge not started. In my backend the CU is available at this moment. Could you do a check in your log system to watch what happened and to find the cause that has generated the warnings?
Thanks and Regards.
Software Version: v4.0.11-0-g0b7d164
OCPP Backend Connection: No

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0403381-DC/Si-D/IT-[MP / RD 170003001] Out of service CRM:01811000644
additional_info.body:
Dear Luigi Iodice,
After reviewing the logs, we found two errors during the charging stop:
1. ERR_EVCOM (EV Communication Issue): A communication problem between the vehicle and the charger.
2. Normal Shutdown
:
Charging stopped due to a timeout during the stop charge phase.
Can you please provide details on the EV you're trying to charge (make/model), and let us know if the same EV has been charged previously without any issues?
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
